summary: Allow 20 seconds for the isolated admission version child to finish cold runtime startup under background scheduling, retaining a bounded indeterminate timeout.

replay.detail: No replay, claim-fold or restart ordering changes.

schema.detail: No cache, diagnostic, database or wire format changes.

rules.detail: Only the version deadline changes from 5 to 20 seconds. The contract deadline remains 45 seconds, with the same checks, inherited scheduling policy, cache order, identity algorithm, invalidations and operator override.

compatibility.detail: The existing source-based probeDigest changes, requiring fresh omp and OpenCode measurements at each host's next applicable launch. Deploy with the admission attempt diagnostics in one binary on macOS to remeasure once; background contract checks still must pass within 45 seconds.

downtime.detail: Running providers are unaffected. An unresponsive version child can hold a new launch for up to 20 seconds instead of 5, then is killed and reaped as before.

manual.detail: No cache edit, override or per-seat priority change is required by this update.

recovery.detail: Revert the binary to restore the five-second version deadline; the earlier source identity requires its own exact measurement.
